title_ar: الشيخ يحاضر ضمن البرنامج المصاحب لمسابقة الفاتح الكبرى لتحفيظ القرآن
title_en: The Sheikh Lectures Within the Programme Accompanying the Grand al-Fatih Qur'an Memorisation Competition
body_ar:
شارك فضيلة الشيخ محمد الحسن ولد الددو في البرنامج المصاحب لمسابقة الفاتح الكبرى لتحفيظ القرآن وتجويده في الفترة ما بين (24 /09 – 30 /09 / 2010م) المقامة في طرابلس بالجماهيرية الليبية..

ويشارك في فعاليات هذه الدورة ما يربو عن 140 متسابقا من 73 دولة من مختلف قارات العالم إلى جانب عدد من العلماء والمشايخ والحكام المتخصصين من داخل الجماهيرية وخارجها..

وقد شارك الشيخ في البرنامج المصاحب للمسابقة بمحاضرة حول تدبر القرآن مفهومه وآلياته؛ كما قدم جملة من المحاضرات والدروس العلمية في بنغازي .

يذكر أن هذه المسابقة تنظم سنويا من طرف الهيئة العامة للأوقاف وشؤون الزكاة وتشمل جانبين هما حفظ القرآن الكريم كاملا، وتجويد القرآن الكريم.
body_en:
His Eminence Sheikh Muhammad al-Hasan Ould al-Dedew took part in the programme accompanying the Grand al-Fatih Competition for the memorisation and correct recitation of the Qur'an, held between 24/09 and 30/09/2010 in Tripoli in the Libyan Jamahiriyah.

More than 140 competitors from 73 countries, from the various continents of the world, are taking part in the activities of this session, alongside a number of scholars, sheikhs and specialist judges from inside the Jamahiriyah and outside it.

The Sheikh took part in the programme accompanying the competition with a lecture on reflective engagement with the Qur'an (tadabbur): its meaning and its means. He also delivered a number of lectures and scholarly lessons in Benghazi.

It may be noted that this competition is organised annually by the General Authority for Endowments and Zakat Affairs, and covers two areas: the memorisation of the entire Noble Qur'an, and the correct recitation of the Noble Qur'an (tajwīd).

flags.note: SOURCE DEFECT (house rule 11). The item is published under the CMS date 7 July 2010 but reports, in the past tense, participation in an event held 24–30 September 2010. One of the two dates is wrong in the source. Both have been preserved as given and neither has been corrected. The site should not present the July date as the date of the event.

translator_notes: 'الجماهيرية الليبية' is rendered 'the Libyan Jamahiriyah', the state's own self-designation at the date of the item (2010). It has been kept rather than modernised.
The Arabic uses the present tense ('ويشارك') for the number of competitors and the past tense for the Sheikh's own participation; the English keeps both tenses as they stand.
